why_the_frozen_artifacts_were_not_edited: analysis/v6_cycle_protocol.json is a preregistration artifact; the V6 rules make changing it after results a new experiment rather than a continuation, and it was provably byte-unchanged from its freeze commit until the editorial rename recorded under editorial_changes below (2026-08-30, V7 P2: gates D1-D9 -> V6-D1..V6-D9, semantics unchanged, hash pins untouched). Silently rewriting a stale hash inside it would destroy exactly the provenance the artifact exists to carry. The corrections are therefore recorded here and pinned by tests/test_v6_provenance.py instead. Separately observed on 2026-08-30: the protocol authority block's skill_sha256 and plans_index_sha256 no longer match the committed SKILL.md and PLANS.md -- both were legitimately edited after registration (test-count correction, V6 termination, V7 registration) without refreshing the pins; recorded here rather than rewritten.
